subject: Post-discovery: propose demo time blocks + evidence handoff
messages:
From: Emma Clark <emma.clark@cloudcorp.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@cloudcorp.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Quick recap + next step (deep dive)

Thanks for the call earlier, Diego — good overview. Quick recap from our side:
- CloudCorp is evaluating inference platforms for a searchable analytics feature (sensitive telemetry, PII concerns).
- Primary concerns: security evidence (SOC 2, data segregation), SSO/SAML and audit logs, and predictable latency/cost.
- Stakeholders to include in the next conversation: Rajiv (infra lead) and Emily (procurement).

Can we move from discovery to a technical deep dive / demo focused on SSO, data handling, and perf numbers? We have time next week and would prefer a 60–75 minute window.

Would appreciate if you can also share SOC 2 artifacts or a summary PDF we can run by our security team in advance. Also note procurement will want a mutual action plan and any standard NDA/PO instructions.

Thanks — Emma
Emma Clark | Director, Product Integrations
CloudCorp
From: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Emma Clark <emma.clark@cloudcorp.com>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@cloudcorp.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 16:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next step (deep dive)

Emma — great to connect earlier, thanks for the clear summary.

Immediate next steps from our side:
1) I'll propose two 75-minute windows for the technical deep dive so we can cover SSO, audit logs, SOC 2 evidence, and a live latency demo:
   - Option A: Tue, Nov 17 — 10:00–11:15 AM PT
   - Option B: Wed, Nov 18 — 2:00–3:15 PM PT
2) Looping in Karthik (SE) to lead the live demo and Marissa (CS) to cover mutual action plan and onboarding cadence.
3) Attaching a short SOC 2 snapshot and deployment diagram for your security team to review ahead of the call.

Attachments: redwood_SOC2_snapshot_v3.pdf (summary), inference-deploy-arch.png (high-level). I can also drop a mutual-action-plan template if helpful.

Two quick clarifying Qs before we lock time:
- Do you want a short section on cost/unit economics for a production workload (tokens/embedding volume)? We can include sample throughput numbers.
- Is there any data residency or on-prem requirement beyond SSO/audit logs?

If one of the proposed windows works, I'll send a calendar invite and include a pre-read and a short agenda.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
